notes.title: Demo now available
notes.content: [p]Following the tradition of doing everything the wrong way round, I've now uploaded a demo of the game to Steam. [/p][p]It contains 3 of the 20 endings, 5 of the 50 eras to explore, and saving is disabled.[/p][p][/p][p]Also, a few people in the [url="https://discord.gg/MgsX2tUQkb" buttoncolor="#761cbf"]Decade Discord [/url]have asked about the game's soundtrack. Personally, I'm a bit too disappointed in how it turned out to release it officially, but for the purpose of satisfying curiousity I've uploaded it [url="https://drive.google.com/file/d/13P_df_ZV9xkUMbqhUovfWGjsFx9lIZqk/view" buttoncolor="#ff3131"]here[/url]. [/p][p]Since the game seems to be taking people around 4-5 hours to complete, and the soundtrack is around 4 hours, I imagine there are many parts which the average player doesn't even get around to hearing.[/p][p]Feel free to use any part of it yourself for samples or whatever (I did do some nice sound design in places).[/p]

notes.title: Steamdeck/Linux testing and a new Discord
notes.content:
[p]UPDATE:[/p][p]There is now a build working on linux. Please check[url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/3272360/discussions/0/604158165590757615/"] this thread [/url]to see how to get it working.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p][strike]I'm currently trying very hard to get the game steamdeck compatible but it's in a very rough state, and my testing is slow due to having to use a virtualbox.   If anyone is kind or knowledgeable enough to lend a hand please [url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/3272360/discussions/0/604158165590757615/"]check out this thread[/url] or head on over to [url="https://discord.gg/MgsX2tUQkb"]the new discord[/url] (where of course, you can just talk about the game or post whatever you want.[/strike]

[/p]
